algorithm: Increased safety stock (S_over_mean) and demand response to better handle demand spikes while maintaining higher target_forecast_gain to react to changing demand patterns. Adjusted inventory_gain to be more aggressive in reducing orders when projected inventory is high. The parameters were tuned to better balance holding and lost-sales costs given the exponential demand distribution.
